panels.description: Countof custom realms without master realm access. This query checks two ways, through the old direct assignment to "realmname-realm-admin" role, and assignment via the "realmname Realm Administrator" group. All custom realms should have access through one of these two ways.

targets.rawSql:
with master_admin_roles as (
  select * from keycloak_role where name ilike '%-realm-admin' and realm_id = 'master'
),
realms_with_users_in_master_admin_role as (
  select REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '-realm-admin$', '') as realm_name from master_admin_roles where exists (
  select * from user_role_mapping join user_entity on user_role_mapping.user_id = user_entity.id 
  where role_id = master_admin_roles.id 
  and username not like 'service-account-%')
),
custom_realm_admin_groups as (
  select * from keycloak_group where realm_id = 'master' and name ilike '%Realm Administrator'
),
realms_with_users_in_admin_groups as (
  select email, replace(name, ' Realm Administrator', '') as realm_name from 
  user_group_membership join custom_realm_admin_groups on user_group_membership.group_id = custom_realm_admin_groups.id
  join user_entity on user_group_membership.user_id = user_entity.id
)
select count(name) from realm where name not in (select realm_name from realms_with_users_in_admin_groups)
and name not in (select realm_name from realms_with_users_in_master_admin_role)
and name not in ('standard', 'master', 'idir', 'github', 'bceidbasic', 'bceidbusiness', 'bceidboth', 'azureidir', 'otp');

panels.title: Custom realms without master realm admin access
